scope: Explicit cooperative database host formula ports derived from authenticated GDA source contracts

contracts.registration: createDatabaseFunctions(query), injected through runtimeFunctions identically for SDK and command engines

contracts.authority: Host owns connection selection, read-only enforcement, single-statement parser, execution, typed conversion and cooperative cancellation; no ambient DSN registry, credentials, SQL engine or GUI is provided

qualificationLimits: Full native GDA GUI/connection/type/date/format lifecycle qualification remains open.
